activity_summary: You came home between the play and the supper, washed, and put on a dry band. You told them the boxes held seven pound eleven and that the yard went out quiet. You did not explain it. The letter stayed on the desk. You went back out for half past six.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Washed, named the sum, and went back for the supper.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Gave him the water and did not keep him past the hour.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the band and left the letter where it was.

facets.activity: Washed, and went back to the supper

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Seven pound eleven at the doors.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: There is warm water in the copper if you want the sizing off your brow.
